╭─ Rewind ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ rewind to refactor the session store so pages load lazily                    │
│                                                                              │
│   1  Conversation and code  rewind the conversation and restore files from   │
│      the snapshot                                                            │
│   2  Conversation only  rewind the conversation, keep files as they are      │
│ ❯ 3  Code only  restore files from the snapshot, keep the conversation       │
│                                                                              │
│ ↑/↓ select · 1-3 pick · Enter apply · Esc back                               │
